text:
maya: Quick heads-up 1 - I've opened a consolidation PR to replace several small 429/timeout/context-limit pages with one canonical error-ref. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4312

samir: Love it. Can we include compact SDK drop-in snippets that show graceful fallback + the recommended retry header? I'll add Node + Python. Keep them tiny so devs can copy/paste.

lisa: Also need a migration note for teams on the old 'short-circuit' retry handler. Some customers saw duplicate retries after switching. Recommend a single-line guidance and the header to set: X-RI-Retry-Mode=graceful.

samir: Draft Node snippet (minimal):
```js
// fallback to cheaper model on 429, attach retry metadata
const r = await client.generate({ prompt });
if (r.status === 429) {
  await client.generate({ model: 'gpt-lite', headers: { 'X-RI-Retry-Mode': 'graceful' } });
}
```

samir: Draft Python snippet (minimal):
```py
# short-circuit fallback for 429
resp = client.generate(prompt)
if resp.status_code == 429:
    client.generate(prompt, model='gpt-lite', headers={'X-RI-Retry-Mode': 'graceful'})
```

jordan: Add a tiny policy example to explain latency/quality tradeoffs. Keep it short.

jordan: policy example:
```json
{ "preferred": "gpt-4-std", "fallback_order": ["gpt-4-small", "gpt-3.5-lite"], "max_latency_ms": 400 }
```

lisa: For context limits: show a before/after prompt-trim example and recommend trimming conversational history first, then system anchors. Include a console tip: `context-trim --preserve=system --max-tokens=2048`. One short paragraph is enough.

alex: Edge-case for troubleshooting: streaming + 429 during chunked responses. Add: if you get a 429 mid-stream, abort and mark the response partial; for resumable streams, include last-token-offset in header `X-RI-Resume-Token` so clients can resume.

doc-bot: lint: docs/error-ref.md — 2 broken links, 1 style warning. CI details: https://ci.redwood.dev/4620/logs

samir: I'll take Node snippets and the SDK link fixes (old retry page links). Will push a follow-up commit later today.

lisa: I'll write the migration paragraph and the context-trim before/after example. ETA tomorrow morning.

maya: Who will run the post-merge link sweep? There are internal cross-links in devex and several SDK pages that need redirects to the new canonical error-ref.

jordan: I can scan product and SDK pages and file redirects for ambiguous cases. Will report back any tricky redirects here.

maya: Plan: fix CI broken links, land the PR Friday COB. Please add a troubleshooting bullet for streaming partials + 429 (alex's note) and a one-line observability example showing `X-RI-Route=dedicated` so support can correlate fallback events.

alex: Also suggest a tiny tracing header example: `X-RI-Trace=team-id:request-id` for easier traces queries.

maya: Added to the checklist. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
